g.text: CI/CD pipeline: what runs, when, and from which file
Pull requests only check. A merge to main checks again, then publishes and deploys dev. Every job below is a real job in the APP REPO (gitops-apps): .github/workflows/ci.yaml.
APP REPO (gitops-apps): ci.yaml - runs on every PR and merge
GITOPS REPO (gitops-monorepo): ci.yaml - every config change, incl. the bot's dev commits
validate: helm lint + template + kubeconform + promtool alert rules
no build, no deploy: ArgoCD applies config changes itself
on a PR the pipeline stops here:
needs: [changes, test, e2e] # only build if tests and e2e passed
packages: write # push images to ghcr.io
id-token: write # keyless cosign signing (GitHub OIDC)
push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }} # PRs build + scan only; main also pushes
# Job 5: "deploy" = commit the new tag+digest into the GitOps repo (environments/dev). ArgoCD does the rest.
name: deploy dev (+ qa branch on release)
if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' # never on PRs
pattern: image-* # one small JSON per built app: app, tag, digest, version
# Write access to the GitOps repo = a deploy key (SSH) stored as secret GITOPS_DEPLOY_KEY.
# It can push to that ONE repo only: no API access, cannot open or merge PRs.
# 1) Build for amd64 and load it locally so we can scan before anything is published.
load: true # keep the image in the local Docker, do NOT push yet
# 2) Gate: fail on CRITICAL vulnerabilities that have a fix available. HIGH is reported only.
report() { { echo "### ${{ inputs.app }} - image scan"; echo '```'; tail -n 30 trivy.txt; echo '```'; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; }
name: is this a new release?
# If the version tag already exists, this is just a normal build (sha tag only).
image="${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}"; sha_tag="${{ steps.meta.outputs.sha_tag }}"; version="${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
if docker buildx imagetools inspect "$image:$version" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
# 4) Sign the digest (keyless, Sigstore). Verify with:
GitOps repo: opens the qa PR
app repo: reusable, called by ci.yaml
